name: Costly Menace
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. Places are Classic’s, shown on the Forever maps. Quest text © Blizzard Entertainment.

narrative.details:
Ain't nothin' that irks me more than losin' these here beautiful horses.  And believe me, we've lost quite a few between them pesky undead creeps, the dang Syndicate gang and all the other good-for-nothin' scoundrels pokin' about these parts.

But I swear on my ol' grand-daddy's grave there ain't no bigger menace to our horses here than them Mountain Lions up in Alterac.  Always comin' down from the hills and makin' my life difficult!

You fancy yourself a hero?  Go and do somethin' about it then!
narrative.objectives: Darren Malvew of Southshore wants you to kill 8 Mountain Lions and 10 Hulking Mountain Lions.
narrative.offerRewardText: Ain't that great news! Should-a gone and found me a regular ol' war hero from day one to take care of them beasts. You'd-a made your pappy proud, adventurer.
narrative.requestItemsText:
Mountain Lions killin' off our horses left and right and here you are wantin' to jibber-jabber about the weather and what not.

Ought to go and find myself a real hero. More killin' and less talkin'.
